clips.title: The story
paras: Foggy MacKreel is an intrepid dwarf stranded precariously on the ruined lower masonry of the Thandol Span. Despite the shattered stonework beneath his feet and the dizzying drop below, his only real concern is fulfilling his moonshine delivery north to Southshore.

Perched on the broken pylons beneath the shattered Thandol Span, Foggy MacKreel appears utterly unfazed by his perilous predicament. While Dark Iron sabotage and war damage have left the grand bridge between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands fractured, MacKreel treats his precarious footing as a minor inconvenience. His primary thought is not his rescue, but an undelivered batch of potent moonshine destined for the patrons of Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He readily hires passing adventurers nimble enough to reach his ledge to finish the courier run on his behalf.
